transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm mainly here because I'm having some trouble at work. I'm a nurse, and on the floor, I just... I lose my train of thought constantly. 

It's like, if an IV pump beeps, or I hear someone asking another nurse a question, or a call light goes off... I just suddenly forget whatever patient flow issue I was working on. It's... yeah, it's just becoming a problem.
Have you always struggled with this kind of distractibility throughout your life, or is this a relatively new issue for you?

Um... no, it's not new. I guess it's always been like this. 

Even back in elementary school... my teachers would write on my report cards that I was bright, but careless. I was always losing worksheets, or... forgetting to turn in my homework. My mom actually had to sit with me every night just to keep me on track. So... yeah. Not new.
Do you find that you spend a significant amount of your time feeling excessively worried or anxious about a variety of different things in your daily life?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I stress about work sometimes, but... I don't think I'm an overly anxious person. Just... normal stuff, I guess.
Do you often feel like you have an internal motor that keeps you going, or do you frequently find yourself talking excessively or interrupting others?

Um... I don't really feel like I have a motor, I guess. But... I do talk a lot sometimes. 

Like... at work, during shift handoff, or if I'm mentoring a newer nurse. I just... I end up giving way too much background, and I kind of talk in circles. I'll notice people glancing at the clock, or... they try to jump in, but I still have a hard time just wrapping it up. So... yeah. I guess I do that.
When you are in situations where you are expected to stay seated, such as in meetings or during long training sessions, do you often find it difficult to remain in your seat?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I can stay seated just fine. It's not... I don't feel like I need to get up and walk around or anything. I just sit there.
Outside of work, do you find that you frequently make careless mistakes in your daily activities, such as when managing your finances or keeping track of personal appointments?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I pay my bills and stuff. I don't think I make a lot of mistakes with that kind of thing. Just... normal, I guess.
